g.text: The measurement limits of the unchanged pipeline
Original 10.1/20.1 s, NW=4, seven tapers, 0.5–20 Hz; all HH/EL/HG inputs retained subject to the published response and SNR rules.
Useful sites contribute ≥20 SNR-passing samples; the fitted stack must span ≥one decade. No threshold was relaxed to obtain a smaller-event relation.
